name: pokokit-gallery
description: Pokokit Gallery frontend for browsing public and owned Pokopia scenes.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/verify-bundle-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:production: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/verify-bundle-secrets.mjs && node scripts/verify-production-config.mjs
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build:production && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.98.0 pages deploy dist --project-name pokokit-gallery --branch main
scripts.verify: pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build
